evals.prompt: I'm about to write the password reset flow in src/auth/reset.ts — what rules should I keep in mind before I start typing?
evals.expected_output: A coaching digest for `auth` in TypeScript: top SAST rule IDs with CWEs, common pitfalls, language-tailored PASS/FAIL snippets, and an offer to run sast-scan after.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml and uses derived.primary_package_manager (or the .ts extension) to fix the language as TypeScript
Runs `vulnetix scan --list-default-rules -o json | jq` filtered by tag `auth` to enumerate the rule digest
Calls `vulnetix vdb cwe list --keyword auth -V v2 -o json` piped through skills/_lib/jq/cwe.jq for CWE intel
Renders the coach output with a numbered Top rules to honor list including rule-id and CWE-XXX references, plus a Common pitfalls bullet list and PASS / FAIL TypeScript snippets
Offers a follow-up `sast-scan --paths src/auth/reset.ts` once the user finishes writing, and performs no memory.yaml writes

evals.prompt: Coach me on crypto — I need to add AES envelope encryption for tenant data in a Go service.
evals.expected_output: Rule digest for the crypto topic with Go-tailored PASS/FAIL snippets, CWE intel pulled from vdb cwe, and a sast-scan follow-up suggestion. No memory writes.
expectations: Uses the explicit topic `crypto` (does not infer from a file) and pulls rules via `vulnetix scan --list-default-rules -o json | jq '[.rules[] | select(.tags | contains(["crypto"]))]'`
Runs `vulnetix vdb cwe list --keyword crypto -V v2 -o json` piped through the cwe.jq filter for CWE-327 / CWE-326 style guidance
Tailors PASS/FAIL code snippets to Go (e.g. crypto/aes, crypto/cipher GCM mode) rather than a generic language
Lists at least one rule-id with its CWE mapping in the Top rules to honor section
Performs no writes to .vulnetix/memory.yaml — coaching only — and offers `sast-scan` as the verification step

evals.prompt: Before I add the dynamic SQL builder to src/reports/query.py please walk me through what a reviewer would flag.
evals.expected_output: SQL-topic coach for Python: rules filtered by `sql` tag, CWE-89 intel, Python PASS/FAIL snippets contrasting parameterized queries against string concatenation, and a sast-scan follow-up.
expectations: Detects topic as `sql` either from the file content (Read on src/reports/query.py) or argument keyword and detects Python from the .py extension / primary_package_manager
Pulls the rule digest with `vulnetix scan --list-default-rules -o json | jq` filtering for the `sql` tag
Calls `vulnetix vdb cwe list --keyword sql -V v2 -o json` for CWE-89 guidance through the cwe.jq filter
Renders PASS snippet using parameterized queries (e.g. cursor.execute with placeholders / SQLAlchemy text bindings) and FAIL snippet showing f-string or % concatenation, both in Python
Offers `sast-scan --paths src/reports/query.py` as the post-write verification and writes nothing to memory.yaml
